documentation_access.access_note: The API and Binance web documentation hosts were not in the current effective egress allowlist; source URLs are cited but not represented as fetched bytes. C02 local source notes describe the OI history unit ambiguity and current observation schemas.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical contract listing/status, tick size, quantity step, minimum notional and lifecycle
inventory.candidate_primary_source: Current USDⓈ-M exchangeInfo and dated official listing/delisting notices
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: Current exchangeInfo is a current-state response; C04 has no dated metadata snapshots. No exhaustive official historical filters archive was identified in the bounded source review.
inventory.original_units: price_tick=USDT per base/contract; quantity_step and minimum_quantity=contract/base units; minimum_notional=USDT
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Current response time and capture time do not establish prior effective filters or when a 2024 system could know them.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Required at every historical eligibility and sizing decision; current metadata cannot substitute.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: Missing point-in-time status/filter changes, inactive symbols and complete historical universe. Individual dated announcements may recover selected events only.

inventory.data_requirement: Exact historical rolling 24-hour ticker; OHLCV-derived turnover approximation
inventory.candidate_primary_source: USDⓈ-M 24hr ticker endpoint; Binance USDⓈ-M klines for quote-volume approximation
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: Current ticker endpoint is a current rolling observation. Binance kline archives include quote asset volume; C04 holds 5m/15m/1h/4h July-October 2024 bars for seven declared symbols.
inventory.original_units: quote_volume=USDT; base_volume=base asset; price=USDT per base asset
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Historical sum is available at the latest completed bar close only as a proxy; five-minute bins cannot reproduce arbitrary intrabar rolling ticker windows.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Can approximate a turnover screen at bar boundaries from existing authentic candles.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: Not an exact venue ticker observation and no original archive publication/ingestion timestamps. Does not imply a spread or executable liquidity.
inventory.c02_acceptance_condition: Only as Ticker24h with fidelity BAR_DERIVED_APPROX, declared proxy availability and complete components; not as venue-reported exact ticker.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical open interest with qualified units and USDT notional
inventory.candidate_primary_source: USDⓈ-M openInterestHist endpoint; candidate data.binance.vision metrics archives
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: The official endpoint documentation states only the most recent 30 days are retained; that page was not fetched in this run. C04 has no OI archive. Four candidate monthly/daily paths for SOLUSDT and DOGEUSDT returned 404.
inventory.original_units: openInterest and sumOpenInterest are exchange-native quantity; sumOpenInterestValue has unspecified units in existing C02 documentation. Do not infer USDT notional.
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: History rows carry a timestamp and requested sampling period; archive payload timestamp and availability were not inspected. API capture time is not the original 2024 availability time.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Mandatory C02 gate and strategy context. The documented API retention cannot serve the frozen window in 2026.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: 404s apply only to candidate paths. No raw archive, verified unit, sampling semantics or historical receive timestamp was recovered.
inventory.c02_rejection_reason: Existing scanner fails closed unless unit_validated is true and open_interest_notional_usdt is populated.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical best bid/ask and 60 one-minute spread samples
inventory.candidate_primary_source: USDⓈ-M bookTicker endpoint and possible data.binance.vision bookTicker archive
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: Current endpoint gives the best bid/ask at request time. No C04 quote observations were retained; the tested 2024 candidate returned 404.
inventory.original_units: bid/ask=USDT per base asset; quoted quantity=base/contract units; spread=fraction of midpoint
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Current capture time is known only for a live request. No historical quote event or ingestion timestamp was recovered.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: C02 requires 60 consecutive fresh one-minute samples; this feed would qualify spread only if historical snapshots existed.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: One candidate URL only; no proof of global archive absence. OHLCV cannot reconstruct bid/ask quotes.

inventory.candidate_primary_source: USDⓈ-M order-book endpoint and candidate bookDepth archive
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: A candidate SOLUSDT 2024-09-02 bookDepth archive object responds HTTP 200 to HEAD. No C04 depth rows were retained.
inventory.original_units: Not inspected; expected order-book quantities and prices, but whether full levels or aggregated depth bands is unverified.
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Archive payload time convention and original 2024 availability are unverified; retrieval now supplies no historical ingestion time.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Potential sampled liquidity evidence only if the archive schema and cadence match the decision points.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: HEAD only, no bytes or schema. Aggregated depth bands are not full order-book snapshots; neither proves queue priority or executable IOC fill.
inventory.c02_acceptance_condition: Would require verified ordered bid/ask levels and timestamp/availability semantics compatible with DepthSnapshot.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical USDⓈ-M trade chronology and aggressor side
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: Binance README documents USD-M aggregate/raw trade fields and archive publication cadence. Monthly SOLUSDT Sep and DOGEUSDT Oct aggTrades and SOLUSDT Sep trades objects returned HTTP 200.
inventory.original_units: price=USDT per base; quantity=base; aggregate/raw trade IDs; buyer-maker boolean; quote quantity where raw trades provide it
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Exchange transaction time in milliseconds is event time. Binance README says monthly archives appear on the first Monday of the month; actual 2024 live ingestion time is absent.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Can recover authentic trade chronology for bounded retrospective A01 diagnostics after download, parsing and continuity checks.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: HEAD only; body size, checksum, row coverage and corrected archive version not inspected. Aggregate trades coalesce executions and do not reveal queue/fill probability.
inventory.c02_acceptance_condition: Only with complete IDs/continuity, TRADE_AGG fidelity, explicit availability proxy, exact source units and no claim of historical live ingestion.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical funding rates and settled funding cash flow
inventory.candidate_primary_source: Binance USDⓈ-M fundingRate monthly archives and Get Funding Rate History endpoint
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: Monthly archive objects for SOL Sep and DOGE Oct returned HTTP 200. Exact payload content/row dates were not inspected.
inventory.original_units: fundingRate=fraction of settlement notional; exact settlement cash flow also requires position quantity/contract multiplier and mark-price notional
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: C02 maps fundingTime to event/settlement time and treats rate as settled. Use settlement time only as an availability proxy for realized cash flow; it is not a rate known at an earlier entry.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Historical rate events can support outcome-side funding accounting if matching position exposure and settlement price are available.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: No archive bytes, source ingestion time, mark-price alignment or actual account funding ledger. The rate alone is not a full cash-flow record.
inventory.c02_acceptance_condition: Settled FundingObservation with fraction units and explicit event-time availability proxy; do not expose a future settled rate at entry time.

inventory.data_requirement: Historical account-specific maker/taker fees and actual paid fees
inventory.candidate_primary_source: Binance account trade/commission records; public Futures fee schedule for declared assumptions only
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: No account fee ledger exists in the C04 artifacts; a current public schedule does not establish a 2024 account tier or paid fee.
inventory.original_units: fee amount in settlement currency; maker/taker rate in fraction of executed notional
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Requires each actual fill/fee event time and the account tier/discount then in effect; none was retained.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Mandatory net economics input; fixed assumed rates are sensitivity parameters, not paid-fee evidence.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: No account history and no public historical tier archive identified. No private access or credentials used.

inventory.candidate_primary_source: Official Binance notices, original token/project/security notices, time-stamped macro schedule and reputable news feeds
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: C04 has no verified event records. The project specification requires original publication and fetch times; it states historical event studies require the originally observable publication time.
inventory.original_units: Event timestamps with timezone/date precision; canonical symbols and event types; no scalar unit.
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: published_at and fetched_at are both required. Later news cannot establish earlier awareness or clearance.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Missing verified event clearance blocks the C02 historical universe at every sampled window.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: No single complete negative-coverage record across exchange, project, security, macro and reputable news sources; absence of articles is not clearance.

inventory.data_requirement: Actual order latency, IOC/partial-fill probability, queue position, stop slippage and realized execution costs
inventory.candidate_primary_source: AstraBot timestamped order/fill/OMS records and exchange execution updates; public book/trades are contextual only
inventory.source_date_coverage_claim: C04 contains no actual submissions or fills; the one-second IOC is unresolved from its 5m candles.
inventory.original_units: order/fill quantity in contract units; prices in USDT per contract/base; latency in milliseconds; realized fee/slippage in USDT
inventory.timestamp_and_availability_meaning: Requires local submit/receive timestamps and exchange acknowledgments/fill event times; public trades do not expose AstraBot's queue or account fill.
inventory.relevance_to_2024_window: Needed to evaluate entry attrition, partials, stop tails and realized net_R for a full policy.
inventory.completeness_and_fidelity_limitations: No historical account/OMS log. Market archives cannot synthesize hidden queue state or actual order outcomes.

missing_mandatory_feeds: all empirical market, event and execution evidence
research_paths.implementation_complexity: low; C04 already exercises core synthetic paths
research_paths.invalid_conclusion_risk: high if synthetic outcomes are presented as strategy performance

recommendation.reason: C04 OHLCV cannot recover original quote, OI, event, metadata or fill histories. Prospective capture is the only identified path that can create fresh availability timestamps for a later untouched economic evaluation.
recommendation.next_task: Implement an unauthenticated read-only prospective collector for SOLUSDT and DOGEUSDT only; persist raw metadata snapshots, trades, bookTicker, bounded depth, mark/funding and OI with source and ingestion timestamps, units, checksums and gaps. Add no account, signing, tuning or order code; declare a later observation horizon before replay.
recommendation.owner_help_needed: NONE for this preflight; a durable read-only runtime and retention horizon must be confirmed before observations begin.
